name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
summary: A button that opens a month to pick one date or a range, with a clear button once set.
use_when: A due date, a start date or a reporting period in a form or filter bar
Dates people pick by looking at a month rather than typing
avoid_when: A date of birth or any date far away: use Input with a date format
A month always on screen: use Calendar

props.placeholder: string: "Pick a date" or "Pick dates" by default

copy.placeholder: "Pick a date"; the label says which date

a11y: The trigger is a button; the month opens in a popover with Calendar's arrow-key grid
The clear button is named "Clear date" and sits outside the trigger
